info.description: Tests Solvia's OWN API surface — the exact calls the Solvia checkout page makes. The app itself talks to the PayPal sandbox server-side (create order -> buyer approves on sandbox.paypal.com -> capture); this collection drives and asserts the app's side of that flow: POST /api/paypal/create-order, POST /api/paypal/capture, GET /verify, POST /api/chat/extract. Honest shapes only: without sandbox keys configured, create-order and capture answer the app's real 503 'not configured' body, and the test scripts assert that shape too. See postman/README.md for import + run steps.

request.description: Creates the PayPal sandbox order for one permit application. The amount is NEVER in this request — the server takes it from the application's snapshotted PriceCents (the college's real fees.csv fee). Set the permitApplicationId variable first (see README). A $0 FREE permit answers { "id": null, "free": true } with no PayPal call at all.

request.description: Captures an approved sandbox order. Run request 1 first — it stores the new order id in the paypalOrderId environment variable. Between create and capture, the buyer approval happens on sandbox.paypal.com in the browser checkout flow (a human click with a sandbox buyer account); capture against an unapproved order honestly answers completed: false.
